opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: A fund started in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft to support postdoctoral researchers to achieve their full potential and enhance their commitment to physiology, benefiting the wider community of physiologists. Funds may be used for consumables, HEA Fellowship registration or other justifiable sundries (not staff salaries).

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research.

opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Value and frequency vary with membership category.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at Society meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers registration, meeting dinner(s), and a contribution toward travel and accommodation.
